messages:
morgan: Quick follow-up from the attention-kernel RFC — we need to convert the open questions into concrete operational chores for Triton vs CUTLASS. Goal: a short checklist + owners we can ship next sprint. High level: perf matrix, fallback interface, CI/bench coverage, canary plan.

anya: +1. I'll take perf matrices and the sample prompt set. Want to keep the matrices small: 3 seq lengths (128/512/2048) x 3 batch sizes.

samir: I can run microbench fleet runs on A100 and T4. Need the docker images and a perf script. Can we agree on a canonical command?

kevin: On the fallback ABI: proposal is minimal runtime interface with 3 calls: init_context, forward_chunk, serialize_kv. Keeps runtime adapter tiny and deterministic. I can draft a PR for an interface header.

irina: Test cases we should add to CI:
- kv-cache invariant tests (rollforward/rollback)
- partial sequence recovery (simulate preemption)
- memory pressure OOM-handling (graceful fallback)
Where do we put artifacts? s3 perf bucket?

diego: Perf dashboards: https://perf.redwood.example/org/attn-kernel (link to current dashboards). I already have a baseline for llama-7b. Will add 13B next.

ci-bot: Scheduled canary run: attn-kernel/canary-triton -> queued on infra-runner-3 at 1802103600.

morgan: Samir, use this as the canonical benchmark command (put in scripts/bench/README):
```bash
./bench/run_attn.sh --model llama-13b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --impl triton --runs 20
./bench/run_attn.sh --model llama-13b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --impl cutlass --runs 20
```

samir: perfect. I'll wire that into fleet-runner and push images to gcr.io/redwood/bench:attn-2026-03-18.

anya: For the perf matrix ownership: I'll own aggregation + regression detection. Action: define pass/fail thresholds (latency p95 > baseline * 1.15 flag) and signal to roll back.

kevin: On compatibility: we need an integration test that runs both implementations against the same random seed and checks token-stream equivalence (modulo allowed numerical tolerance). I'll add a small harness in runtime/tests/attn_eq.cu.

irina: CI plan:
- unit: attn_eq (fast) on PRs
- perf-nightly: full perf matrix (long)
- canary: staged rollout to dedicated nodes for 24h then promote
I'll open CI job specs.

morgan: Action item list (short):
1) samir: fleet microbench + images (ETA Tue)
2) anya: perf aggregation + thresholds (ETA Wed)
3) kevin: ABI header + equivalence harness (ETA Fri)
4) irina: CI job specs + artifact location (ETA Wed)
5) diego: dashboard + baseline 13B (ETA Thu)
6) ci-bot: kick canary once builds are green (auto)

kevin: Question: do we need to commit to a single canonical implementation for default runtime or allow dynamic routing by policy? I think allow dynamic routing but default to Triton on A100, CUTLASS on RTX if latency wins.

morgan: prefer flexible routing. We'll surface policy in routing config: fallback_order: [triton, cutlass, cpu]. Keep defaults in runtime-config.yaml.

anya: also consider embedding quantization compatibility tests — quant profiles differ between impls. Add a quick smoke test.

samir: note: CUTLASS build on our CI currently fails for some fused kernels (link to CI failure thread). I'll debug after fleet job.

irina: If CUTLASS fails, fallback plan is to route affected model variants to Triton until fix. We need an automatic marker in the dashboard that can flip routing for a model id.

morgan: Agreed. We'll implement a model-routing toggle in the console + config API. Diego, add a widget to dashboards to flip routing and show traffic split.

diego: on it. Will also surface the regression alert and a single-click rollback.

ci-bot: Canary completed: triton vs cutlass microbench queued -> results at https://perf.redwood.example/job/1802103600/results (pending).

morgan: Ok — I'll file GH issues for each action item and tag owners. Will post a short RFC-followup note in the design docs once PRs land. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

kevin: +1. I'll drop a minimal header RFC link once it's up.

anya: leaving a note: prefer to keep perf matrices & sample prompts public in repo under benchmarks/attn so SEs can run locally.

samir: once I get images, I'll post exact gcr digest in the thread.

morgan: closing loop — expect a status update at our sync next Mon. If anything blocks earlier, ping here. :eyes:
